json_schema.description: Asks for an agent to be spawned. NOT a contract: it is a request, and the intent/committed pair the dispatcher writes underneath it is what carries the outstanding-work accounting. M3a's workflow engine owns request lifecycle. NOT spillable: a spawn request recorded only in a local spill file would be invisible to every dispatcher, so it would read as work nobody is doing. A prompt longer than the 8KiB payload CHECK must go to a content-addressed artifact (M3a) rather than inline — the append fails loudly rather than truncating.
